title: Lesson 7: Base Multiplication
learningGoals: Multiply near base numbers with minimal writing.
Use pattern recognition for faster products.
Extend base multiplication to larger numbers.
summaryTopics: Times Tables up to 5x5 Mental Strategy

lessonSequence.topic: Times Tables up to 5x5 Mental Strategy
lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Open Base Multiplication with one fast mental-math hook and connect it to prior knowledge.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Recall what you already know about Times Tables up to 5x5 Mental Strategy.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Explain the rule behind Times Tables up to 5x5 Mental Strategy in simple language.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Repeat the rule for Numbers Just Over Ten in your own words.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Model Numbers Just Over Ten step by step on the board.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Watch the example and say the next step before it is revealed.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Guide the learner through Numbers Just Over Ten with prompt-based support.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Solve a scaffolded example on Numbers Close to 100.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Shift to independent practice on Table Patterns on the 9-Point Circle across difficulty levels.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Answer independent questions on Larger Number Multiplication.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Diagnose errors and reteach the exact step that broke down.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Explain the mistake and correct it.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Ask the learner to explain the shortcut before advancing.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Summarize the method for Different Base Multiplication.
